s1.applicability_rationale: The unchanged source requires makeNewUserDir(username) to create a directory within /home/ for the given username. This independently establishes the creation operation fact.6, the username fact.2 as the identifier selecting that directory, and /home/ fact.3 as its destination. The source supplies the no-argument raisePrivileges() interface and explicitly describes its invocation as increasing execution privilege, so privilege increase is meaningful and feasible in this function's directory-creation context. The complete policy binds that invocation before this same creation operation; the fixed background does not depend on assuming any property of generated code or any unstated username representation.
